definition: Reproduce PYF baseline before evaluating candidates
pass_condition: Must calculate for every included position

definition: Spearman rank relationship between candidate rank and outcome finish
pass_condition: Must report candidate PYF and delta

definition: Position-level Spearman rank relationship
pass_condition: Must report all positions or explicitly scoped position

definition: Precision among rows predicted as startable under NWR review format
pass_condition: Must not materially worsen versus PYF without caveat

definition: Precision or hit rate for top-12 where relevant
pass_condition: Must report for QB/RB/WR/TE where meaningful

definition: Precision or hit rate for top-24 where relevant
pass_condition: Must report for RB/WR where meaningful

definition: Precision or hit rate for top-36 where relevant
pass_condition: Must report for WR where meaningful

definition: Mean absolute rank error where meaningful
pass_condition: Must report with caveat
caveat: Rank error is not production accuracy

definition: Root mean squared rank error where meaningful
pass_condition: Must report with caveat

definition: Difference between candidate and PYF metrics
pass_condition: Must show direction and size

definition: Error delta on sparse-history rows
pass_condition: Must not materially worsen sparse-history rows

definition: Error delta on low-games rows
pass_condition: Must not materially worsen low-games rows

definition: False-positive concentration in prior-decline or high-volume prior-production slices
pass_condition: Must report count share and delta

definition: Change in PYF false positives
pass_condition: Can be promising only without broad harm

definition: Change in PYF false negatives
pass_condition: Must protect breakout rows

definition: Metrics by age and lifecycle buckets
pass_condition: Must report older elite and young sparse-history harm risks
caveat: Age is not a direct score

definition: Metrics by role archetype and role buckets
pass_condition: Must report high-volume and low/sparse misses
caveat: Role is not a direct score

definition: Rows non-null values and fallback counts
pass_condition: Must report before result interpretation

definition: Season-by-season candidate delta versus PYF
pass_condition: Must flag unstable or sign-flipping candidates

definition: Check whether candidate direction remains positive when each season is omitted
pass_condition: Feasible candidates must report direction count

definition: Confirm all inputs are decision-date safe
pass_condition: Any failure stops affected candidate

definition: Document use gate for every input
pass_condition: Ambiguous or blocked gate stops affected candidate
